summary: This clinical trial studies how a drug called semaglutide affects blood vessel health in adults with type 2 diabetes or obesity. Researchers want to see if the drug helps preserve or increase the number of vessel-repairing cells in the blood over a period of six months. The study compares participants receiving semaglutide injections to those receiving usual care without the drug. This is a Phase 4 study with an enrollment of 100 participants.

facts.sponsor: Canadian Medical and Surgical Knowledge Translation Research Group
